```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(xgboost)
library(randomForest)
library(doParallel)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
set.seed(2025)       # reproducible splits


#Functions
#GAM fitting function
train_one_gam <- function(df_train) {
  gam(deltaSOC ~ s(MAP) + s(MAT) + s(MPE) + s(Cinput) + s(CARB30),
      data = df_train)
}

#Model perfomance functions
score_model <- function(model, df_test) {
  preds <- predict(model, newdata = df_test)
  mse   <- mean((preds - df_test$deltaSOC)^2)

  ss_res <- sum((preds - df_test$deltaSOC)^2)
  ss_tot <- sum((df_test$deltaSOC - mean(df_test$deltaSOC))^2)
  r2     <- 1 - ss_res / ss_tot

  mape  <- mean(abs(df_test$deltaSOC - preds) / abs(df_test$deltaSOC)) * 100
  smape <- mean(2 * abs(preds - df_test$deltaSOC) / (abs(preds) + abs(df_test$deltaSOC))) * 100
  #Performance results
  tibble(MSE = mse, R2 = r2, MAPE = mape, sMPAE = smape)
}

#Data reading and group function
process_dataset <- function(path) {
  df <- read_rds(path)
  tex_levels <- c(Fine = 3, Medium = 2, Coarse = 1)
map_dfr(names(tex_levels), function(tex_name) {
    df_tex <- df %>% filter(TEXT == tex_levels[[tex_name]])

    # skip if too few rows to split
    if (nrow(df_tex) < 10) return(NULL)

    idx_train <- createDataPartition(df_tex$deltaSOC, p = 0.70, list = FALSE)
    train_df  <- df_tex[idx_train, ]
    test_df   <- df_tex[-idx_train, ]

    model <- train_one_gam(train_df)
    scores <- score_model(model, test_df)

    # optionally save each model
    saveRDS(model,
            file = glue("Output/GAM_{tex_name}_{basename(path)}"))

    scores %>%
      mutate(dataset = tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(path)),
             texture = tex_name,
             .before = 1)
  })
}


```

## This MD builds GAMs models for 1- 6y moving average data. The data is grouped by their soil texutre 


```{r run the model}
#Build data list
data_files <- list.files("Input", pattern = "^SiteData_\\dy\\.rds$",
                         full.names = TRUE)

#read, modelling, test performance
metrics_all <- map_dfr(data_files, process_dataset) %>%
  mutate(year = parse_number(dataset))

print(metrics_all)

```


## Draw plots to compare the results, not that model performance of 5-y average convergence

```{r plot for moving average}
#Pivot the table
metrics_long <- metrics_all %>% 
  pivot_longer(c(MSE, R2, sMPAE), names_to = "metric",
               values_to = "value")

#Plot results
ggplot(metrics_long,
       aes(year, value,
           colour = texture,
           group  = texture)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ metric, scales = "free_y") +         # each metric gets its own scale
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = sort(unique(metrics_long$year))) +
  labs(x = "Moving-average window (years)",
       y = "Metric value",
       colour = "Texture") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

```
